prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one Victoria 3 TECHNOLOGY icon for Mouvements réformistes / organized reform movements. Single painted object cutout, not a flat PM pictogram and not a building scene.
Primary request: a plain wooden public speaker's rostrum / tribune d'orateur, evoking secular reform meetings in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth century. One compact piece of furniture: a broad rectangular paneled front, two short side panels, a slightly sloped reading top with a simple lip, and a small raised wooden base with one low integral step. The rear is open for a standing speaker, but there is NO speaker or person. The reading surface is empty. No church pulpit, cross, gothic carving, microphone or modern equipment.
Composition: slightly elevated three-quarter view showing the top and one side; a compact balanced silhouette centered in a square at least 1024x1024, with comfortable fully transparent margins. The broad reading top, paneled wooden body and small base should be recognizable at 48 and 64 pixels. Entire object visible, no cropping.
Style/medium: restrained hand-painted volumetric game illustration, like the painted objects of native Victoria 3 academia and democracy icons. Broad brushed masses and simplified details, short soft highlights, subtle natural oak/walnut grain and matte aged medium-brown wood. The top catches soft light while recesses are dark brown; keep enough midtone contrast to read on the dark game UI. No uniform sepia tint, blue cast, glossy 3D product render, photorealistic furniture shot, cartoon sticker, thick black outlines, flat cut-paper PM graphic or excessive ornate detailing.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the object and in all open gaps; all four corners fully transparent. No black/gray painted background, scenery, room, floor, surrounding cast-shadow patch, round medallion, frame or app-icon tile.
Constraints: exactly one wooden rostrum. NO writing, letters, numbers, plaques, emblems, banners, flags, paper, book, quill, crown, liberty cap, candles, hands or people. No watermark, logo, UI elements or added props. Output the single finished raster icon, not a contact sheet.
visual_research_queries: tribune orateur assemblée nationale bois révolution française
antique wooden speakers rostrum 19th century public meeting
research_usage: Visual context only; no claim that this generic rostrum reproduces an exact historical object. No remote images downloaded.
